definition: a person who shapes clay on a wheel
description: In a pottery workshop in an old wooden barn, a woman with her hair tied back, in an apron over a denim dress, sits at a spinning wheel and shapes a tall grey clay vase with wet, clay-covered hands. The view starts very close on her hands inside the vase and moves back until the whole workshop is visible. Beside the wheel are a bucket, a sponge and small tools. Behind her another person works at a second wheel, shelves hold rows of pots and an orange kiln glows by the sunlit barn door.
